name: Construction
hero_sub: Creating durable and innovative infrastructure that shapes skylines and transforms landscapes.
overview: From residential developments to large-scale civil works, our construction division combines engineering discipline with modern technology to deliver structures built to last. We manage every stage — planning, design, construction and handover — with rigorous quality control and safety standards.

name: Mining
tagline: Responsible resource extraction and mining solutions
hero_sub: Harnessing modern technology to responsibly extract valuable resources while prioritizing sustainability and safety.
overview: Our mining division applies modern technology and strict environmental stewardship to resource extraction. Every operation is planned with sustainability, community responsibility and the highest safety standards at its core, so that value is created for generations rather than extracted at their expense.
capabilities: Mine site rehabilitation and environmental care
equipment: Certified safety protocols and trained crews

name: Real Estate
hero_sub: Developing premium properties designed around comfort, security, luxury, and long-term investment opportunities.
overview: Our real estate division develops and manages premium residential and commercial properties. From family homes to commercial spaces and investment land, every property is designed around comfort, security and lasting value — with transparent processes from first viewing to final handover.

name: Transportation
tagline: Transportation, logistics, import and export solutions
hero_sub: Facilitating seamless global trade through reliable, efficient, and secure transportation and logistics solutions.
overview: Our transportation and logistics division keeps supply chains moving — by road, sea and air. From freight forwarding and cargo handling to import/export clearing and distribution, we provide reliable, efficient and secure solutions that connect businesses to markets near and far.
equipment: Partner shipping and air cargo network

name: Imports/Exports & Distribution
tagline: Global trade, customs clearance and distribution solutions
hero_sub: Facilitating international commerce with expert customs clearance, trade documentation and end-to-end distribution services.
overview: Our Imports/Exports & Distribution division connects businesses to global markets. From customs clearance and trade compliance to warehousing and last-mile distribution, we manage the entire supply chain with precision and reliability. Whether you are importing raw materials or exporting finished goods, our team ensures smooth, timely and cost-effective delivery across borders.
